chambordchateau.name: Château de Chambord
chambordchateau.slogan: A king's hunting lodge with 440 rooms and a skyline of its own.
chambordchateau.line: Its double-helix staircase lets two people climb at once without meeting; the château has 282 fireplaces.

chenonceauchateau.name: Château de Chenonceau
chenonceauchateau.slogan: A gallery of light stretched across the Cher.
chenonceauchateau.line: We played music there and staged comedies.

amboiseclosluce.name: Clos Lucé
amboiseclosluce.slogan: Where Leonardo sketched his last inventions.
amboiseclosluce.line: Leonardo da Vinci came to France in 1516 at Francis I's invitation and died here on 2 May 1519.

toursgatien.name: Saint-Gatien Cathedral
toursgatien.slogan: Eight centuries of Gothic, crowned by two Renaissance towers.
toursgatien.line: Its east end is unique among European Gothic cathedrals: no other buildings are attached to it.

villandrygardens.name: Villandry Gardens
villandrygardens.slogan: Cabbages and box hedges laid out like a Renaissance tapestry.
villandrygardens.line: Spanish doctor Joachim Carvallo bought the château in 1906 and recreated its Renaissance gardens, ornamental kitchen garden included.

waive_area_cap: Loire châteaux outside Tours are the region's defining sights
